Maya (Docs): Quick PR: add a tiny short-seq example showing microBatch + kvPrefetch + q4_profile and a migration note for old param names. Landing under examples/optimize/shortseq-microbatch.md

Arun (SDK): Sweet. Use canonical SDK names: microBatch, kvPrefetch, quantProfile. For JS show Promise; for Py show stream.

Pri (ML): Add one-line: q4 profiles are best on A100/T4; run a 100-prompt smoke eval before flipping.

Maya (Docs): Draft JS snippet:
```js
const { OptimizeClient } = require('@redwood/optimize-client');
const c = new OptimizeClient();
const r = await c.generate({ model: 'rwkv-7b', prompt: 'TL;DR', maxTokens: 48, microBatch: 6, kvPrefetch: true, quantProfile: 'q4_0' });
console.log(r.text);
```

Arun (SDK): Tiny nit: r.text -> text is correct; also CI harness expects exact package name @redwood/optimize-client.

Maya (Docs): Updated. Added migration anchor: batch_size -> micro_batch, prefetch_kv -> kv_prefetch. Also a safe perl codemod example.

ci-bot: running snippet-tests + md-lint + link-check for PR branch.

Arun (SDK): Hm, infra had a delay with the alias rollout. For now change require to @redwood/optimize to satisfy harness or add note in CONTRIBUTING.

Maya (Docs): Switched require to '@redwood/optimize' and added a short CONTRIBUTING note about test env package names. Pushed fix.
